clue.text: Scant leaves on a regular basis — is plant OK?

indicators.note: what is left when alternate letters of the word scant are kept, taking every other one

parts.note: a plant is an industrial works, a factory

explanation.surface: A gardener worries whether a sparsely leafed plant is healthy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaves' looks like foliage but means 'leaves behind': the odd letters of Scant, SAT, are what is left.
explanation.definitionFit: Something satisfactory is acceptable, all right, which is what OK conveys.

clue.text: Fashionable pen starts to leak ink, staining hand

parts.note: a sty is a pen for pigs

indicators.note: the opening letters of the following four words are taken

explanation.surface: A fountain pen leaks ink and stains the writer's hand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pen' reads as a writing implement but is a pig enclosure.
explanation.definitionFit: Stylish and fashionable are synonyms for being smart and up to date.

clue.text: Transport quick to turn up

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up means reading the word from bottom to top

parts.note: smart can mean brisk or quick, as in a smart pace

explanation.surface: Transport that is quick to appear when you need it.
explanation.definitionFit: Trams are streetcars, a form of public transport.

clue.text: Cuckoo lacking feeling?

definitions.meaning: literally without senses, numb or unconscious

explanation.surface: Is someone crazy simply because they feel nothing?
explanation.definitionFit: Senseless covers both foolish or mad and unconscious, deprived of sensation.

clue.text: Spots note inside card

indicators.note: the note letter is placed within the card word

parts.note: an ace is a playing card

explanation.surface: Spotting a note tucked into a greetings card.
explanation.definitionFit: Acne is a skin condition producing pimples, which are spots in British usage.

clue.text: Will producer examine a rocky hill?

parts.note: to test is to examine
a tor is a rocky hill, as on Dartmoor in England

explanation.surface: Will a producer look over a rocky hill as a location?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Will' looks like the auxiliary verb but is a legal document.
explanation.definitionFit: A testator is the person who makes a legal will before death.

clue.text: Some complain a workman's climbing tree

indicators.note: in a down clue, climbing means the letters go upwards, read in reverse
only part of the run of letters in the words that follow is used

explanation.surface: A labourer grumbles while going up a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The rowan, or mountain ash, is a tree with red berries.

clue.text: Smashing book about what Charles has become?

parts.note: re means about or concerning
Charles III became a king, of the United Kingdom, in 2022

explanation.surface: A sensational book about the monarch's new role.
explanation.definitionFit: Breaking a window is smashing it, the present participle in each case.

clue.text: Pressure on each group of teachers formerly to get something to eat

parts.note: P is the symbol for pressure in physics
the NUT, the National Union of Teachers, merged into a new union in 2017

explanation.surface: A teachers' union under pressure earning a snack.
explanation.definitionFit: A peanut is a legume eaten as a snack, so it is food.

clue.text: Wants variable income

parts.note: y is a standard algebraic variable
earnings are income

explanation.surface: Someone with an uneven salary has needs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'variable' looks like it describes income, but stands alone as the letter Y.
explanation.definitionFit: Yearnings are longings, the things a person desires, as a plural noun.

clue.text: With nag, husband's left more disagreeable

indicators.note: husband has gone, so that letter is removed from the horse word

parts.note: a nag is an old horse

explanation.surface: A wife's nagging has driven her husband away, making things worse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nag' looks like a scold but is a horse.
explanation.definitionFit: Worse is the comparative of bad, so more unpleasant or disagreeable.

clue.text: Children with singular problems

parts.note: issue means offspring, a person's children, in legal language

explanation.surface: Kids with unusual difficulties.
explanation.walkthrough: 'singular' looks like 'unusual' but is the grammatical abbreviation S.
explanation.definitionFit: Issues are matters of concern, points of difficulty or trouble.

clue.text: Keep sea vessel outside area

parts.note: the main is a poetic word for the open sea

indicators.note: the vessel word sits round the area letter

parts.note: a tin is a container, a vessel

explanation.surface: Keep the ship out of the zone.
explanation.definitionFit: To maintain something is to keep it going or keep it in good condition.

clue.text: Swindled Conservative departs furious

indicators.note: the Conservative letter leaves the swindled word

parts.note: cheated means swindled
C is short for Conservative, the British political party

explanation.surface: A conned Tory storms off in a rage.
explanation.definitionFit: Heated describes an angry, impassioned state, like a heated argument.

clue.text: Had to remove top and make uniform good enough

indicators.note: in a down clue the top of a word is its first letter, which goes

parts.note: to equate is to make equal or uniform

explanation.surface: Someone forced to take off their hat to make their uniform pass muster.
explanation.definitionFit: Adequate means sufficient, satisfactory but no more.

clue.text: Dispute about working with female left one in front of court

indicators.note: the letters before it come ahead of the court abbreviation

parts.note: C is short for circa, about
on means operating or working
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A legal row over a working woman who walked out before her case was heard.
explanation.definitionFit: A conflict is a disagreement or clash, which is what a dispute is.

clue.text: Fed no bird nuts — it's banned

indicators.note: nuts means crazy, so the letters of the phrase are scrambled

explanation.surface: A sign forbids feeding nuts to the birds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nuts' looks like bird food but signals the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Forbidden means prohibited, not allowed, the same as banned.

clue.text: Fish after parking and dad's picked up tackle

indicators.note: the fish comes after the parking letter
in a down clue, picking up means lifting the letters so they read upwards

parts.note: pa is an informal word for dad
P is the symbol for parking
a roach is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: An angler's dad collects his fishing gear after parking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tackle' looks like fishing gear but is a verb, as in tackle a problem.
explanation.definitionFit: To approach a task is to set about it or tackle it.

clue.text: Urge to increase small exercises

parts.note: to press is to urge
to up is to increase

explanation.surface: A coach pushes for a few more reps.
explanation.definitionFit: Press-ups are gym exercises where you push the body off the floor with the arms.

clue.text: Found squeezing European's heavenly body

indicators.note: the found word holds the European letter tightly within it

parts.note: to found a colony is to establish or plant it

explanation.surface: A founding father squeezes a European in.
explanation.definitionFit: A planet is a celestial object orbiting a star, an astronomical body.

clue.text: Awful convulsive twitch holding newspaper

indicators.note: the twitch word grips the newspaper word

parts.note: a tic is an involuntary spasm
rag is slang for a low-quality newspaper

explanation.surface: Someone's hands shake terribly as they hold the paper.
explanation.definitionFit: Tragic means dreadful or calamitous, close in sense to awful.

clue.text: Business trouble

explanation.definitionFit: Concern means both a going commercial enterprise and a cause of anxiety.

clue.text: Laud new attempt to cover last of one's unfaithfulness

indicators.note: new signals that the letters of laud are made afresh in another order
the attempt word wraps around the final letter

parts.note: a try is an attempt

indicators.note: the closing letter of the word one is taken

explanation.surface: Praising a fresh effort to hide one's infidelity.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of one's is only a link: just the word one supplies its last letter, and 'Laud' reads as praise but is anagram fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Adultery is marital infidelity, being unfaithful to a spouse.

clue.text: Teach artist without money? On the contrary

indicators.note: here without means outside, enclosing
the roles are swapped, so the money goes round the artist rather than the reverse

parts.note: tin is old British slang for money
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: Teaching an impoverished painter, or rather the opposite.
explanation.definitionFit: To train someone is to instruct or teach them a skill.

clue.text: Instrument I love endlessly playing at home

indicators.note: playing suggests the letters are played around with and rearranged
the last letter of love is cut off

parts.note: in means at home

explanation.surface: Someone says they adore playing music in their own house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'playing' turns I and LOV into VIOL.
explanation.definitionFit: A violin is a stringed musical instrument played with a bow.

clue.text: Person who doesn't want company car finally going after large one

indicators.note: the final letter of car is used

explanation.surface: A solitary motorist pulls in behind a big vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going after' puts the R after L and ONE.
explanation.definitionFit: A loner is someone who prefers to be by themselves, avoiding others.

clue.text: Lower centre of dartboard

definitions.meaning: a lower is something that lows, or moos
the ..., or bullseye, is the middle of a dartboard

explanation.definitionFit: A bull is a male bovine that moos, and the bullseye target at the heart of a dartboard.

clue.text: Cross after eastern craft turned over

indicators.note: the cross comes after the eastern letter

parts.note: X is the shape of a cross

indicators.note: the craft word is turned round, read backwards

parts.note: art is craft or skill

explanation.surface: Anger after an Eastern boat capsized.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' looks like part of 'turned over' but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Extra means additional, left over, more than is needed.

clue.text: Host a ball, following food

indicators.note: the ball comes after the food

parts.note: a bun is a bread roll, a kind of food
a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: A host throws a ball once the food is served.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Host' looks like the party-giver but means a great number.
explanation.definitionFit: A host is a large crowd or number, so it means plenty or abundance.

clue.text: Eventually hot then failing to finish marathon?

parts.note: in and hot both mean fashionable

indicators.note: the final letter of then is lost

parts.note: a marathon is a long run

explanation.surface: A runner overheats and then fails to complete the marathon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'failing to finish' also suits the marathon story, but cuts only THEN.
explanation.definitionFit: In the long run is an idiom for ultimately, over time.
